create or replace function public.srk_worker_get_my_rate_card()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, auth
as $function$
declare
  v_worker_type text;
  v_worker_share numeric(5,2);
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required' using errcode='42501';
  end if;
  select wp.worker_type into v_worker_type
  from public.srk_worker_profiles wp
  where wp.user_id=auth.uid()
  limit 1;
  if v_worker_type is null or v_worker_type not in ('technician','helper') then
    raise exception 'Worker profile is required' using errcode='42501';
  end if;
  select 100-coalesce((ss.setting_value #>> '{}')::numeric,15.00)
    into v_worker_share
  from (select 1) seed
  left join public.srk_system_settings ss on ss.setting_key='company_commission_rate';
  v_worker_share:=coalesce(v_worker_share,85.00);

  with rate_rows as (
    select c.id category_id,s.service_name,null::text skill_level_name,
      'प्रति घंटा'::text rate_label,
      round((case when v_worker_type='helper' then r.helper_rate else r.technician_rate end)*v_worker_share/100,2) worker_rate,
      'प्रति घंटा'::text unit_label,s.sort_order service_sort,0 skill_sort,0 detail_sort
    from public.srk_service_pricing_rules r
    join public.srk_service_categories c on c.id=r.category_id and c.is_active
    join public.srk_service_types s on s.id=r.service_type_id and s.is_active
    where r.effective_from<=now() and (r.effective_to is null or r.effective_to>now())
      and r.pricing_unit='hour'
      and (case when v_worker_type='helper' then r.helper_rate else r.technician_rate end) is not null

    union all

    select c.id,s.service_name,null::text,
      trim(to_char(t.motor_hp,'FM999990.0'))||' HP',
      round(t.fixed_price*v_worker_share/100,2),
      'एक बार का फिक्स चार्ज',s.sort_order,0,t.motor_hp::integer
    from public.srk_service_pricing_rules r
    join public.srk_service_categories c on c.id=r.category_id and c.is_active
    join public.srk_service_types s on s.id=r.service_type_id and s.is_active
    join public.srk_service_pricing_hp_tiers t on t.pricing_rule_id=r.id
    where v_worker_type='technician' and r.effective_from<=now()
      and (r.effective_to is null or r.effective_to>now()) and r.pricing_unit='motor_hp'

    union all

    select c.id,s.service_name,null::text,'प्रति यूनिट',
      round(r.technician_rate*v_worker_share/100,2),
      'प्रति यूनिट फिक्स चार्ज',s.sort_order,0,0
    from public.srk_service_pricing_rules r
    join public.srk_service_categories c on c.id=r.category_id and c.is_active
    join public.srk_service_types s on s.id=r.service_type_id and s.is_active
    where v_worker_type='technician' and r.effective_from<=now()
      and (r.effective_to is null or r.effective_to>now())
      and r.pricing_unit='per_item' and r.technician_rate is not null

    union all

    select c.id,s.service_name,l.level_name,'प्रति घंटा',
      round((case when v_worker_type='helper' then sr.helper_hourly_rate else sr.technician_hourly_rate end)*v_worker_share/100,2),
      'प्रति घंटा',s.sort_order,l.sort_order,0
    from public.srk_service_rates sr
    join public.srk_service_categories c on c.id=sr.category_id and c.is_active
    join public.srk_service_types s on s.id=sr.service_type_id and s.is_active
    join public.srk_skill_levels l on l.id=sr.skill_level_id and l.is_active
    where sr.rate_status='approved' and sr.effective_from<=now()
      and (sr.effective_to is null or sr.effective_to>now())
      and (case when v_worker_type='helper' then sr.helper_hourly_rate else sr.technician_hourly_rate end) is not null
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.srk_service_pricing_rules r
        where r.category_id=sr.category_id and r.service_type_id=sr.service_type_id
          and r.effective_from<=now() and (r.effective_to is null or r.effective_to>now())
      )
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'category_code',c.category_code,
      'category_name',c.category_name,
      'rates',coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'service_name',rr.service_name,'skill_level_name',rr.skill_level_name,
          'rate_label',rr.rate_label,'worker_rate',rr.worker_rate,'unit_label',rr.unit_label
        ) order by rr.service_sort,rr.skill_sort,rr.detail_sort,rr.rate_label)
        from rate_rows rr where rr.category_id=c.id
      ),'[]'::jsonb)
    ) order by c.sort_order
  ),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_result
  from public.srk_service_categories c
  where c.is_active and c.category_code in (
    'electrician','plumber','painter','ac_fridge_technician',
    'motor_pump_technician','cooler_technician'
  );
  return v_result;
end
$function$;
revoke all on function public.srk_worker_get_my_rate_card() from public,anon;
grant execute on function public.srk_worker_get_my_rate_card() to authenticated;

create or replace function public.srk_worker_get_my_booking_financial_details(p_booking_id uuid)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, auth
as $function$
declare
  v_worker uuid;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required' using errcode='42501';
  end if;
  select wp.id into v_worker
  from public.srk_worker_profiles wp
  where wp.user_id=auth.uid()
  limit 1;
  if v_worker is null then
    raise exception 'Worker profile not found' using errcode='42501';
  end if;
  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.srk_worker_earnings e
    where e.booking_id=p_booking_id and e.worker_id=v_worker
  ) then
    raise exception 'This booking has no earning record for the signed-in worker' using errcode='42501';
  end if;

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'booking_id',b.id,
    'bill_number',fb.bill_number,
    'bill_status',fb.status,
    'booking_status',b.status,
    'payment_status',b.payment_status,
    'payment_method',case when lower(b.payment_method) in ('upi','card') then 'online' else lower(b.payment_method) end,
    'customer_paid_amount',case
      when lower(coalesce(b.payment_status,'')) in ('paid','completed')
      then coalesce(b.amount_paid,fb.total_amount,0)
      else coalesce(b.amount_paid,0)
    end,
    'bill_total',fb.total_amount,
    'labour_total',fb.service_amount,
    'discount_amount',fb.discount_amount,
    'tax_amount',fb.tax_amount,
    'cancellation_fee_amount',fb.cancellation_fee_amount,
    'commission_rate',e.company_commission_rate,
    'company_commission_total',coalesce((
      select sum(all_e.company_commission)
      from public.srk_worker_earnings all_e
      where all_e.booking_id=b.id
    ),0),
    'worker_earnings_total',coalesce((
      select sum(all_e.net_earning)
      from public.srk_worker_earnings all_e
      where all_e.booking_id=b.id
    ),0),
    'my_worker_role',e.worker_role,
    'my_gross_allocation',e.gross_service_earning,
    'my_company_commission',e.company_commission,
    'my_net_earning',e.net_earning,
    'my_settlement_status',e.settlement_status,
    'my_payout_status',e.payout_status,
    'my_wallet_credit',coalesce((
      select sum(l.balance_effect)
      from public.srk_worker_wallet_ledger l
      where l.earning_id=e.id and l.entry_type in ('earning','refund_adjustment')
    ),0),
    'my_cash_commission_due',coalesce((
      select -sum(l.balance_effect)
      from public.srk_worker_wallet_ledger l
      where l.earning_id=e.id and l.entry_type='cash_commission_due'
    ),0),
    'cash_commission_outstanding',greatest(0,-coalesce((
      select sum(l.balance_effect)
      from public.srk_worker_wallet_ledger l
      where l.worker_id=v_worker
        and l.entry_type in ('cash_commission_due','cash_commission_collected')
    ),0)),
    'bill_items',coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'item_type',i.item_type,
        'description',i.description,
        'quantity',i.quantity,
        'unit',i.unit,
        'unit_price',i.unit_price,
        'line_total',i.line_total
      ) order by i.created_at,i.id)
      from public.srk_booking_final_bill_items i
      where i.bill_id=fb.id and lower(i.item_type)<>'material'
    ),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) into v_result
  from public.srk_worker_earnings e
  join public.service_bookings b on b.id=e.booking_id
  join public.srk_booking_final_bills fb on fb.id=e.bill_id
  where e.booking_id=p_booking_id and e.worker_id=v_worker
  order by e.created_at desc
  limit 1;
  return v_result;
end
$function$;

create or replace function public.srk_worker_get_my_payout_requests()
returns table(
  payout_id uuid,
  payout_code text,
  requested_amount numeric,
  approved_amount numeric,
  status text,
  payment_method text,
  payment_reference text,
  admin_note text,
  requested_at timestamptz,
  reviewed_at timestamptz,
  paid_at timestamptz
)
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, auth
as $function$
declare v_worker uuid;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required' using errcode='42501';
  end if;
  select id into v_worker
  from public.srk_worker_profiles
  where user_id=auth.uid()
  limit 1;
  if v_worker is null then
    raise exception 'Worker profile not found' using errcode='42501';
  end if;
  return query
  select p.id,p.payout_code,p.requested_amount,p.approved_amount,p.status,
    p.payment_method,p.payment_reference,p.admin_note,p.requested_at,
    p.reviewed_at,p.paid_at
  from public.srk_worker_payout_requests p
  where p.worker_id=v_worker
  order by p.requested_at desc
  limit 50;
end
$function$;

revoke all on function public.srk_worker_get_my_booking_financial_details(uuid) from public,anon;
grant execute on function public.srk_worker_get_my_booking_financial_details(uuid) to authenticated;
revoke all on function public.srk_worker_get_my_payout_requests() from public,anon;
grant execute on function public.srk_worker_get_my_payout_requests() to authenticated;

-- Keep booking details and phone numbers hidden from offered workers.
-- Mobile apps use these narrowly scoped RPCs; contacts are returned only after acceptance.
drop policy if exists srk_booking_participant_read on public.service_bookings;
create policy srk_booking_participant_read
on public.service_bookings
for select
to authenticated
using (
  is_srk_admin()
  or srk_has_admin_permission('bookings.manage')
  or customer_user_id = (select auth.uid())
);

create or replace function public.srk_worker_get_my_assignments()
returns table (
  assignment_id uuid,
  booking_id uuid,
  worker_role text,
  assignment_status text,
  offer_expires_at timestamptz,
  service_type text,
  booking_status text,
  state text,
  district text,
  pincode text,
  address text,
  booking_latitude double precision,
  booking_longitude double precision,
  requested_duration_hours integer,
  pricing_unit_snapshot text,
  work_start_approval_status text,
  work_start_requested_at timestamptz,
  completion_approval_status text,
  completion_requested_at timestamptz,
  payment_method text,
  payment_status text,
  final_bill_id uuid,
  final_bill_number text,
  final_bill_total numeric,
  final_bill_status text,
  quote_status text,
  service_charge numeric,
  quoted_amount numeric,
  quote_note text,
  preferred_date date,
  preferred_time text,
  work_details text
)
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, auth
as $function$
declare
  v_worker_id uuid;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required' using errcode='42501';
  end if;

  select w.id into v_worker_id
  from public.srk_worker_profiles w
  where w.user_id = auth.uid()
    and w.verification_status = 'approved'
    and w.is_active = true
  limit 1;

  if v_worker_id is null then
    raise exception 'Approved active Worker profile required' using errcode='42501';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    bw.id,
    b.id,
    bw.worker_role,
    bw.assignment_status,
    bw.offer_expires_at,
    b.service_type,
    b.status,
    b.state,
    b.district,
    b.pincode,
    case when bw.assignment_status in ('accepted','assigned','working','paused','completed')
      then b.address else null end,
    case when bw.assignment_status in ('accepted','assigned','working','paused','completed')
      then b.booking_latitude else null end,
    case when bw.assignment_status in ('accepted','assigned','working','paused','completed')
      then b.booking_longitude else null end,
    b.requested_duration_hours,
    b.pricing_unit_snapshot,
    b.work_start_approval_status,
    b.work_start_requested_at,
    b.completion_approval_status,
    b.completion_requested_at,
    case when bw.assignment_status in ('accepted','assigned','working','paused','completed')
      then b.payment_method else null end,
    case when bw.assignment_status in ('accepted','assigned','working','paused','completed')
      then b.payment_status else null end,
    case when bw.assignment_status in ('accepted','assigned','working','paused','completed')
      then fb.id else null end,
    case when bw.assignment_status in ('accepted','assigned','working','paused','completed')
      then fb.bill_number else null end,
    case when bw.assignment_status in ('accepted','assigned','working','paused','completed')
      then fb.total_amount else null end,
    case when bw.assignment_status in ('accepted','assigned','working','paused','completed')
      then fb.status else null end,
    b.quote_status,
    b.service_charge,
    b.quoted_amount,
    b.quote_note,
    b.preferred_date,
    b.preferred_time::text,
    b.work_details
  from public.srk_booking_workers bw
  join public.service_bookings b on b.id = bw.booking_id
  left join lateral (
    select f.id, f.bill_number, f.total_amount, f.status
    from public.srk_booking_final_bills f
    where f.booking_id = b.id
    order by f.revision_no desc, f.created_at desc
    limit 1
  ) fb on true
  where bw.worker_id = v_worker_id
    and bw.assignment_status in ('offered','accepted','assigned','working','paused','completed')
  order by bw.assigned_at desc;
end
$function$;

create or replace function public.srk_worker_get_my_booking_customer_contacts()
returns table (
  booking_id uuid,
  booking_worker_id uuid,
  customer_name text,
  customer_phone text,
  assignment_status text
)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, auth
as $function$
  select b.id, bw.id, b.customer_name, b.phone, bw.assignment_status
  from public.srk_booking_workers bw
  join public.srk_worker_profiles w on w.id = bw.worker_id
  join public.service_bookings b on b.id = bw.booking_id
  where auth.uid() is not null
    and w.user_id = auth.uid()
    and bw.assignment_status in ('accepted','assigned','working','paused','completed')
    and b.status <> 'cancelled'
  order by bw.assigned_at desc
  limit 100;
$function$;

create or replace function public.srk_customer_get_my_booking_worker_contacts()
returns table (
  booking_id uuid,
  booking_worker_id uuid,
  worker_role text,
  worker_name text,
  worker_phone text,
  assignment_status text
)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, auth
as $function$
  select b.id, bw.id, bw.worker_role, w.full_name, w.phone, bw.assignment_status
  from public.service_bookings b
  join public.srk_booking_workers bw on bw.booking_id = b.id
  join public.srk_worker_profiles w on w.id = bw.worker_id
  where auth.uid() is not null
    and b.customer_user_id = auth.uid()
    and bw.assignment_status in ('accepted','assigned','working','paused','completed')
    and b.status <> 'cancelled'
  order by bw.assigned_at desc
  limit 100;
$function$;

revoke all on function public.srk_worker_get_my_assignments() from public, anon;
revoke all on function public.srk_worker_get_my_booking_customer_contacts() from public, anon;
revoke all on function public.srk_customer_get_my_booking_worker_contacts() from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.srk_worker_get_my_assignments() to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.srk_worker_get_my_booking_customer_contacts() to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.srk_customer_get_my_booking_worker_contacts() to authenticated;

    'tax_amount',fb.tax_amount,
    'cancellation_fee_amount',fb.cancellation_fee_amount,

    'my_cash_commission_due',coalesce((select -sum(l.balance_effect) from public.srk_worker_wallet_ledger l where l.earning_id=e.id and l.entry_type='cash_commission_due'),0),

    'bill_items',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('item_type',i.item_type,'description',i.description,'quantity',i.quantity,'unit',i.unit,'unit_price',i.unit_price,'line_total',i.line_total) order by i.created_at,i.id) from public.srk_booking_final_bill_items i where i.bill_id=fb.id and lower(i.item_type)<>'material'),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) into v_result
  from public.srk_worker_earnings e
  join public.service_bookings b on b.id=e.booking_id
  join public.srk_booking_final_bills fb on fb.id=e.bill_id
  where e.booking_id=p_booking_id and e.worker_id=v_worker
  order by e.created_at desc
  limit 1;

  return v_result;
end
$function$;
